name: sheleg-dev
description: Six integration skills for the layer a product reaches once it has users: money in, tracking, sign-in, and speed.

plugins.name: sheleg-dev
plugins.description: stripe-billing — the seam between Stripe and your database: checkout, renewals, seats and proration, refunds, claim-first webhook idempotency, reconciliation and price drift, plus Stripe's own agent toolchain. crypto-payments — accept crypto without losing money to under-payment, duplicate webhooks or rate drift. ad-tracking — GA4, Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn under Consent Mode v2, with four deep references on the Google tag. google-signin — the GIS ID-token flow with the account pre-hijacking guard and login-CSRF defence on both delivery paths. google-auth — the server side: OAuth 2.0, ADC, service accounts, Workload Identity Federation, Node and Python. frontend-performance — Core Web Vitals, font and CSS compositing, bundle and cache work, plus the accessibility rules that move a Lighthouse score.
